A short survey, however, showed that many visitors were uncertain about how to begin. The survey became a compass: it pointed the team toward clearer labels and a one-page guide. During the next month, completed loans rose from 20 to 31. Asha concluded that the collection had not needed to become larger; it had needed to become easier to navigate.
